entries.name: Laika Urgencias 24 h
entries.duty: Emergency service available 24 hours; call the emergency line.

duty_i18n.es: Servicio de urgencias las 24 horas; horario habitual lun–sáb 9:00–20:00 h.

duty_i18n.es: Línea de urgencias las 24 horas; horario de la clínica lun–vie 10:00–20:00 h, sáb 10:00–15:00 h.

entries.name: Servicio de Emergencia Veterinaria - Intendencia de Montevideo
entries.duty: Municipal 24-hour emergency service for animals injured on public roads and for wild or exotic animals; not a general clinic. WhatsApp 099 019 500 daily 6:00-24:00.
entries.note: Official page: 'las 24 horas del dia'; line 1950 ext. 5000. Aimed at street accidents and families without means; the owner takes responsibility for the animal afterwards. Address is the IM head office from the page.

duty_i18n.es: Servicio municipal de urgencias las 24 horas para animales heridos en la vía pública y para animales salvajes o exóticos; no es una clínica general. WhatsApp 099 019 500 todos los días 6:00–24:00 h.

entries.name: Dr Mascota Hospital Veterinario
entries.address: Ruta Interbalnearia km 23 esq. Gonchi Rodriguez, Lagomar
entries.duty: Emergency care 24 hours a day; daytime consultations until 20:00 Monday to Saturday.
entries.note: Page: 'Atencion emergencias las 24 horas del dia', 'Hospital veterinario'. Page names only 'Lagomar' (a district of Ciudad de la Costa), not the city. Night/day emergency hours inside the affiliation plans are contradictory (20-9 h vs 9-20 h) so only the general 24 h sentence is used. Phone is also WhatsApp.

duty_i18n.es: Urgencias las 24 horas; consultas de día hasta las 20:00, de lunes a sábado.

notes: Uruguay: Montevideo, Maldonado/Punta del Este, Paysandu, Colonia and Young covered partially. No national duty rota, no SMVU/MGAP clinic directory and no animal poison line found: the SMVU (smvu.org.uy) and Facultad de Veterinaria (fvet.edu.uy) home pages could not be opened by the fetch tool (not in the allowed URL set); the faculty Memoria 2023 PDF has no hospital hours or phone; CIAT (human poison centre) was not confirmed to take animal calls. Not done / not reachable: Espacio Animal Montevideo (espacioanimal.uy, anti-bot page, only a search title says 'emergency service'), Hospital Veterinario HV (hvhospitalveterinario.com, anti-bot page), Laika branch addresses (sucursales.laika.com.uy not opened), Puntovet Clinicas page, Veterinarios en Accion (vea.com.uy, redirect loop), Centro Veterinario Salto (only Instagram, robots-blocked), Hospital de Paysandu and other veterinariasuruguay.com pages (robots-blocked), lacosta.com.uy (error), BuenVet, AsistVet, Veterinaria Cavia, Hospital Veterinario de la Costa, Vita Consultorio (Las Piedras), Veterinaria Nan, Clinica Veterinaria Uruguay (Paysandu), La Colonial, Salud Animal and Dr. Sebastian Vazquez (Colonia) - no own site opened. Not covered: Rocha / La Paloma / Punta del Diablo, Piriapolis, Rivera, Tacuarembo, Durazno, Florida, Minas, Mercedes, Carmelo, Ciudad de la Costa, Pando, Las Piedras (no own-site pages found). Follow-up 2026-11-11 (interior and coast): only Dr Mascota (Lagomar) could be confirmed from its own page. Not reachable / not done: smvu.org.uy and fvet.edu.uy home pages (fetch tool refused: URL not in allowed set); faculty PDFs opened (Memoria Hospital 2024, Hoja de informacion 2026, Guia estudiantes extranjeros 2024, Toxicologia syllabus, Caracterizacion Clinicas) contain no Hospital Veterinario hours, phone or urgencias info, only the campus address Ruta 8 km 18; no animal poison line found (CIAT not confirmed; the Toxicologia syllabus names none). UCIL Hospital Veterinario (ucilhospitalvet.wixsite.com/ucil) says '24hs, 7 dias' and RapidVet urgencias 098 503 975 but the page gives no city or address, so it was not added (phones 092 410 061 / 098 503 975). hvhospitalveterinario.com is in Olivos, Argentina (not UY). The MGAP Decreto 160/997 official list (Aug 2026) names clinics but has no phones; own sites were not found by search for: Marvet (La Paloma), Clinica Veterinaria La Huella and La Lechuza (Rocha), Clinica Veterinaria Piriapolis, Animaladas, El Churrinche (Piriapolis), Argos, Cimarron, Dra. Cecilia Ojeda (Rivera), Clinica Veterinaria Avenida and Saravia (Florida), Clinica Veterinaria Sarandi and Veterinaria Minas (Minas), Clinica Veterinaria Olimar and La Veterinaria (Carmelo), Veterinaria Pando, Clinica Integral Veterinaria and La Mulita (Las Piedras), Clinica Veterinaria Parada 5 (Punta del Este), Veterinaria La Ruta and Animalia (Durazno). No candidates at all for Tacuarembo clinics (only agro stores) and none for Mercedes. Guia/veterinariasuruguay.com/guiacomercial pages were seen only as search hits (aggregators, robots-blocked) and not used.
